captions.detailed: A large household room air purifier represented in light gray. It features a main rectangular cabinet with a top exhaust grille, a large rear filter door with a handle, an internal sliding filter pack, and a front control panel with a rotating dial and four square buttons. The rear door swings open on a side hinge, the internal filter pack slides out horizontally, the front dial rotates continuously, and the four buttons can be depressed independently.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a large room air purifier with realistic articulation. Include a main cabinet with a top grille, a hinged rear door with a handle, a sliding internal filter pack, and a front control bank featuring a rotating dial and four independently depressible buttons. Apply appropriate light gray, dark gray, and black materials to distinguish the components.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet using a hollowed-out box primitive with a top grille cutout. Create the rear door from a box with a handle, and attach it to the cabinet via a revolute joint. Model the inner filter pack as a multi-layered box and define its movement with a prismatic joint sliding out of the rear opening. Build the control panel on the front face, adding a cylindrical dial on a continuous joint and four small box buttons on individual prismatic joints.
